01 / About

Curious by nature.

I’m Gbeminiyi, a full-stack developer who enjoys making technology feel simple, useful, and human.

I work across the full product stack—from expressive, accessible interfaces to dependable backends and databases. I care about clean systems, considered motion, performance, and the kind of polish people can feel even when they can’t name it.

I’m always learning, experimenting, and looking for ambitious problems worth solving.
